title: Comparisons Between Modes, Models, and Features
summary: This topic is dominated by comparison-oriented mentions about differences between trims, modes, features, or prior vehicles, with only one clearly positive contrast in service or ownership experience.

positive.summary: The only positive review describes a much better experience than a prior one using a strong day-and-night comparison.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention differences between vehicle variants, drive or climate modes, driver recognition, pricing, and a body-panel gap without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are too short or context-poor to determine sentiment reliably.
The cluster mixes unrelated subjects such as trim comparisons, feature explanations, driver recognition, pricing, prior-vehicle comparisons, and a body-gap mention.
Because almost all examples are undetermined, concrete thematic conclusions are limited.
